query: Oakhaven Basin electricity-consumption level changes during 2012-10-09 13:00 through 2012-10-10 12:00

evidence.claim: Maximum-capacity HVAC operation caused a fivefold increase in regional electricity consumption during 18:00–21:00 on October 9, 2012.
evidence.exact_quote: Building infrastructure is currently operating at maximum capacity to circulate refrigerant and expel heat. HVAC units are being operated far beyond their standard duty cycles to maintain habitability during this demand spike. This sustained mechanical strain is directly linked to the 5x increase in regional electricity consumption observed during this three-hour window.

impacts.rationale: The documented fivefold consumption level is a +400% change from standard demand and directly contradicts persistence of the cutoff level during this three-hour future window.
